dct_description_sm: The purpose of this dataset was to examine differences in foliar nutrients in Betula glandulosa between alder shrub patches and open tundra locations. It has been observed that this species tends to be larger in association with alder and we hypothesized that this may have to do with access to nitrogen fixed by alder's bacterial symbiont. This data will help examine that.
dct_title_s: Betula glandulosa foliar nutrient data from Western Arctic, Inuvik Region
